known_issues: M1 v1.1 algorithm output on this recording is not usable: alpha=0.2 run misses the still occupant (presence rises only at 72 s), alpha=0.02 run false-triggers from 4.1 s for the whole recording; structural cause: empty-seat environmental residual vs slowly-adapted background (37 dB) is only 3.3 dB below occupied lift (40.5 dB), leaving no working point for the EMA background; fix requires design-level change (pre-entry background snapshot / drift compensation)
static gate inert on this hardware: empty-seat environmental low-frequency disturbance (~0.2-0.5 Hz) inflates f23 above floor even when empty
F2/F3 features do not discriminate on this recording (empty phase std 0.024 rad > occupied 0.012 rad, inverted)
static clutter phase drift +8.8 dB/162 s vs fixed reference; M1 release after leave can fail on long recordings

calibration_status='uncalibrated': range bins not mapped to meters; region [1,3] and main_bin 2 are per-seat signal-calibrated (breathing evidence), not geometry-based; do not reuse on other seats/installations

verbal script deviates from measurements: actual seating at ~19.7 s (script said 15 s); scripted 125-140 s leave has no change-point evidence (person did not leave); end-of-recording movement 156.3-162.3 s is unlabeled
two partial frames (0 and 839, missing chirps; quality still 'ok', 1dfft uses valid-chirp mean); chip0/bin0 has 3.1% int16 negative saturation, chain chip1/rx0 selected to avoid it
single recording, single seat (T01), single chain (chip1/rx0): baseline must not be generalized
B0 replay (2dfft) detects motion, not static occupancy (24% occupied-frame detection by design); do not wire B0 presence as the occupancy source for a static-seated user
time base is nominal frame period, not wall-clock; pending confirmation with B-side acquisition (Chen Zhixuan)
